description: This file configures Thymeleaf template engine for a Spring Boot application, defining beans for template resolution, template engine, and view resolution.

classes.name: ThymeleafConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up Thymeleaf template engine in a Spring application.

methods.name: templateEngine
methods.description: Defines the SpringTemplateEngine bean with the specified template resolver.

methods.name: thymeleafTemplateResolver
methods.description: Defines the SpringResourceTemplateResolver bean with prefix, suffix, and template mode.

methods.name: thymeleafViewResolver
methods.description: Defines the ThymeleafViewResolver bean linked to the template engine.
